regional_compliance.tax_context: Federal excise duty on alcohol production administered by CRA, plus provincial markup/taxation through provincial liquor authorities (e.g. LCBO in Ontario, SAQ in Quebec) which often functions as a de facto tax through mandated markup on sales.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Provincial minimum wage applies to bar staff; tip-out rules and protections vary by province.
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: CRA federal excise duty licensing, provincial liquor licensing board (varies significantly by province — some provinces have government-controlled distribution, others allow more private retail), municipal business and health permits.

humanity_mode_regional_addendum.0_percent: Federal excise duty under the Excise Act 2001, provincial liquor authority markup structures functioning as de facto taxation, interprovincial shipping restrictions on alcohol.

learning_objectives: Understand how provincial liquor authority markup functions differently from a simple sales tax in most Canadian provinces.
Analyze how interprovincial shipping restrictions affect a small brewery's ability to sell beyond its home province.

hardStops: Never takes real-world action without HITL approval
Never modifies data outside declared permissionScope
